session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: Yesterday I visited Tianjin Museum with my sister Lily.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: That sounds wonderful, Alice. Which exhibition did you enjoy?

session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: We enjoyed the porcelain exhibition. Lily bought two postcards.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: I am glad you had a good day. I am preparing for a mathematics exam on Friday.

session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: Good luck, Bob! I can help you revise on Wednesday afternoon.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: Thank you for offering to help me, Alice. Let us meet at the university library.
